analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in frame_get_usermeta due to trusting attacker-controlled trailer usermeta_len without validating that trailer_offset + FRAME_TRAILER_USERMETA_OFFSET + usermeta_len stays within frame_len (or sframe buffer length). The function allocates usermeta_len bytes and memcpy()s from frame->sdata past the end of the input buffer, causing the ASan crash at memcpy.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer passes arbitrary bytes to blosc2_schunk_open_sframe() -> blosc2_frame_to_schunk() -> frame_get_usermeta(). A crafted frame with plausible header/trailer offsets but a large forged usermeta_len in trailer triggers the bug. Even with small input (89 bytes), if usermeta_len decodes to a huge positive int32, frame_get_usermeta performs memcpy from frame->sdata+offset for that length without bounds check, reading beyond heap allocation.
